name: aubeNoAutoInstall
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not auto-install before a run. Use `verifyDeps` in nub.jsonc, or `verify-deps-before-run` in .npmrc, to choose what happens when dependencies are stale.

name: ci
unsupportedAdvice: nub detects CI from the `CI` environment variable, not from config. Set `CI=1`, or pass `--frozen-lockfile` / `--no-frozen-lockfile` to pin the install mode.

name: deployAllFiles
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not implement `deploy`. For now: pnpm deploy.

name: enablePrePostScripts
unsupportedAdvice: nub always runs `pre`/`post` scripts for a named script, like npm. Pass `--ignore-scripts` to `nub run` to skip the whole lifecycle.

name: managePackageManagerVersions
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not download or switch package-manager versions. `nub pm pin` records the project's manager, and `nub upgrade` updates nub itself.

name: nodeDownloadMirrors
unsupportedAdvice: nub provisions Node itself and does not read the engine's download mirrors. Install the version another way and `nub node pin` it.

name: nodeVersion
defaultText: output of `node -v` with the leading `v` stripped

name: npmPath
unsupportedAdvice: nub never shells out to npm; every package-manager verb runs in-process.

name: optimisticRepeatInstall
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not auto-install before a run, so there is no repeat install to skip. Use `verifyDeps` in nub.jsonc, or `verify-deps-before-run` in .npmrc, to choose what happens when dependencies are stale.

name: packageManagerStrict
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not enforce another package manager's pin. `nub pm pin` records the project's manager, and `nub pm which` reports the one in force.

name: packageManagerStrictVersion
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not enforce another package manager's pinned version. `nub pm pin` records the project's manager.

name: runtimeInstaller
unsupportedAdvice: nub provisions Node itself rather than delegating to another installer. Manage versions with `nub node install` and `nub node pin`.

name: runtimeOnFail
unsupportedAdvice: nub provisions Node itself and installs a missing pin on demand. Manage versions with `nub node install` and `nub node pin`.

name: scriptShell
defaultText: null (uses /bin/sh on Unix, cmd on Windows)

name: updateNotifier
unsupportedAdvice: nub does not check for its own updates while running a command. Run `nub upgrade` when you want a new version.

name: useStderr
unsupportedAdvice: nub chooses its own output streams. Redirect the command's stdout or stderr in your shell instead.
